manifest.description: Build, deploy, and operate AI agents on AWS. Skills for scaffolding agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Strands, LangGraph), connecting tools via Gateway and MCP, multi-agent and A2A orchestration, memory, Cedar policies, evaluation, observability, debugging traces and logs, and production hardening.
